ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, in the Cartesian coordinate system, the graph of the linear function $y_{1}=kx+b$ ($k\ne 0$) intersects with the graph of the inverse proportion function $y_{2}=\frac{m}{x}$ ($m\ne 0$) at points A and B in the second and fourth quadrants, respectively, and intersects the x-axis at point C. The coordinates of point B are $(n, -2)$. The length of segment OA is $5$, and point E is located on the negative half of the x-axis, with $\sin\angle AOE=\frac{4}{5}$. What is the area of $\triangle AOB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:}\\
As shown in the figure, draw line $BH\perp x$-axis through point B,\\
according to the coordinates of point A and point B, we know: AD=4, BH=2\\
From (1), we know the analytical expression of line AB is $y_{1}=-\frac{2}{3}x+2$\\
When y=0, we get $0=-\frac{2}{3}x+2$, and solve for x to find x=3\\
$\therefore$ the coordinates of point C are (3, 0)\\
$\therefore$ OC=3\\
$S_{\triangle AOB}=S_{\triangle AOC}+S_{\triangle BOC}$\\
$=\frac{1}{2}\times 4\times 3+\frac{1}{2}\times 2\times 3$\\
$=\boxed{9}$\\
$\therefore$ the area of $\triangle AOB$ is $\boxed{9}$

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description first: The diagram shows a Cartesian coordinate system with O at the origin. Point E is marked on the negative x-axis. Point A is in the upper-left region, i.e. quadrant II, and point B is in the lower-right region, i.e. quadrant IV. A and B lie on the same inverse-proportion curve, and the descending straight line passes through A, C on the positive x-axis, and B. Reasoning: Since OA=5 and E lies on the negative x-axis, sin∠AOE represents the perpendicular distance from A to the x-axis divided by OA. Thus the y-coordinate magnitude of A is 5·(4/5)=4. Because A is in quadrant II, y_A=4 and x_A<0. With OA=5, x_A^2+4^2=5^2, so x_A^2=9, hence x_A=-3. Therefore A=(-3,4). Since A lies on y=m/x, m=(-3)(4)=-12. Point B=(n,-2) lies on the same inverse-proportion curve, so n·(-2)=-12, giving n=6. Thus B=(6,-2). The area of triangle AOB using vectors OA=(-3,4) and OB=(6,-2) is S=1/2|(-3)(-2)-4·6|=1/2|6-24|=9.
